Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(janitor)
library(harmony)
library(ggplot2)
library(scCustomize)
library(R.utils)
```

create objects
```{r}
con1 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/con1")
con1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = con1, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
con2 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/con2")
con2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = con2, min.cells = 3,min.features = 200)
con3 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/con3")
con3 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = con3,min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
rif1 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/rif1")
rif1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rif1,min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
rif2 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/rif2")
rif2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rif2, min.cells = 3,min.features = 200)
rif3 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/rif3")
rif3 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rif3,min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
rif4 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/rif4")
rif4 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rif4, min.cells = 3,min.features = 200)
rif5 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/rif5")
rif5 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rif5,min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
rif6 <- Read10X(data.dir = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/rif6")
rif6 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rif6,min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
```


merge
```{r}
lai_all <- merge(con1, y = list(con2, con3, rif1, rif2, rif3, rif4, rif5, rif6), 
                add.cell.ids = c("con1", "con2", "con3", "rif1", "rif2", "rif3", "rif4", "rif5", "rif6"))

#remove individual files
rm(con1, con2, con3, rif1, rif2, rif3, rif4, rif5, rif6)

lai_all[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(lai_all, pattern = "^MT-")
lai_all <- subset(lai_all, subset = percent.mt < 40)

```

QC
```{r}
#Normalize
lai_all <- NormalizeData(lai_all)
#Find variable features
lai_all <- FindVariableFeatures(lai_all)
#Scale
lai_all <- ScaleData(lai_all)
```


```{r}
#Run PCA
lai_all <- RunPCA(lai_all)
ElbowPlot(lai_all)
#identify where the elbow is --> around 9
ElbowPlot(lai_all, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
```

integrate samples together
```{r}
lai_cca <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = lai_all,
  method = CCAIntegration,   # Canonical Correlation Analysis
  orig.reduction = "pca",    # Use PCA for alignment
  new.reduction = "integrated.cca",  # Output integrated reduction
  verbose = FALSE
)

saveRDS(lai_cca, file = "<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/lai_cca_may28")

```

```{r}
lai_cca <- FindNeighbors(lai_cca, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:10)
lai_cca <- FindClusters(lai_cca, resolution = 0.85)

#Visualization using integrated.cca
lai_cca <- RunTSNE(lai_cca, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:10)
```

```{r}
#Visualize with t-SNE
DimPlot(lai_cca, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = T)
DimPlot(lai_cca, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "sample", alpha = 0.5)
DimPlot(lai_cca, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "id", alpha = 0.5)
```


```{r}
VlnPlot(lai_cca, features = "nCount_RNA", group.by = "orig.ident")
```
